scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Self-serve API key with 1,000 monthly free credits stated on current homepage; no card required.
app.surface: REST; scrape, crawl, map, search and extraction
app.note: A crawl is an asynchronous job; implement status handling and explicit credit limits.
app.next_action: Use Firecrawl's documented free allowance for a small owned or permitted site, with an explicit page and credit limit.
app.success_criterion: Record the crawl job ID, poll to a terminal status and return only the allowed page count.
app.alternative_action: Compare official MCP crawl controls with direct API limits before exposing an unconstrained crawl tool.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
